newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Fortis unit AG 1824 to sell La Medicale.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Fortis unit AG 1824 to sell La Medicale.

text.p: AG 1824, an operational unit of Belgian insurer Fortis AG, and Naviga, part of the CMB group, said on Tuesday in a joint statement they had signed a declaration of intention for Naviga to take over AG 1824's unit La Medicale.
No financial details of the deal were given.

La Medicale has a portfolio made up mainly of car, fire, medical and life insurance, and it collected premiums worth 538 million Belgian francs in 1995. Naviga would also take on all La Medicale's staff, the statement said.

"The planned takeover by Naviga offers the best outlook for the future concerning the development of La Medicale's activities, which, in the framework of an integration with a similar sized company, will have the best potential for growth," the statement said.
Fortis AG belongs to Belgian-Dutch insurance and banking group Fortis.
Premiums collected by Naviga and its unit Belgamar totalled two billion francs in 1995, two thirds of which came from transport insurance.
